record.reason: The full text uses selected attention heads in frozen LVLMs to localize visual regions without fine-tuning or extra grounding modules. However, the transformer still runs its forward pass to produce those attention values; the paper’s contribution is grounding capability/quality, not reduction of the model’s inference FLOPs, token count or serving resources.
record.title: Your Large Vision-Language Model Only Needs A Few Attention Heads For Visual Grounding
